svg.title: Which deletion settings you need
svg.desc: The section Trash and deletion safety answers three questions. First, where the copy of a document goes that went to the trash of Paperless: with the Paperless trash behavior Move to deleted folder, the default, it moves into _Deleted, below the day on which the document went to the trash, and comes back when the document is restored; with Keep archive file in place, it stays where it is. Second, whether the copy goes too once Paperless deleted the document for good: leave Delete the Nextcloud copy after Paperless deletes the document for good off, the default, and the copy stays; turn it on, and the copy goes to the trash bin of its user in Nextcloud after N complete scans without the document, where N is the setting Required consecutive missing scans, three by default. Third, with that switch on, whether the copy is deleted too of a document that disappears while the trash doesn't list it, such as one in the trash of another owner, which the account of the app can't see: turn on Also delete copies of documents that disappeared without passing the Paperless trash, and after N complete scans the copy goes to the trash bin of its user, without _Deleted, even if Paperless can still restore the document; leave it off, the default, and after N complete scans the copy moves to _Deleted, or stays in place with Keep archive file in place, and is not deleted. The questions are indigo, the safe defaults green, the other way to keep copies blue and the switches that delete copies amber.
